negative_reviews.author: Faizan iqbal
negative_reviews.text: We walked in almost an hour before this restaurant closes and as soon as we stepped into the building 2 of the staff turned around and had the biggest expression of disappointment and annoyance on the face and started gesturing frustration with there hands as if we’ve just made there life miserable by walking in, right in front of our eyes mind you, rolling their eyes and told us “kitchen is closed kitchen is closed” and as we was walking out the frail skinny man put hands up in happiness and I heard him say “yess” mind you we were still in the building. We went to WoWo which is a Chinese restaurant literally 2 doors away from here, which also closes at the same time as them, and the staff was lovely and our food was delicious. I would consider customer service a bit more given the competition right next to them.
